bands.1:
The Soggy Biscuit sails into thick grey smoke. Redpen Volcano rises out of the sea.

"There is a twelve per cent chance it erupts today," says Tully.

Gus sniffs. "Rotten eggs! That's volcano gas. That's not gross. That's science."

Mo cooks broccoli-and-marshmallow kebabs on the hot rock. The broccoli catches fire.

"What did the volcano say to its sweetheart?" asks Mo. "I lava you!"

Everyone groans. The volcano rumbles too.

On the edge of the crater is a crooked old office. The sign says, "THE REDPEN RUMBLE. ONLY TRUE NEWS."

A huge man stomps out. He has eyebrows like burnt toast and a giant red pen. A little black cockatoo rides on his shoulder. Her crest feathers glow red at the tips.

"Get off my volcano, you lovely... strike that... strangers!" he booms. "I am Chief Editor Krak. I fix words!"

"Your volcano is really, really, really cool," says Zed.

"Cut two 'really's," says Krak. "And try 'fierce'."

"This is Scorchquill," he says. "She burns a line through mistakes."

On his wall is an old front page. It says, "MAXX VANTABLACK IS NOT A HERO."

"I read that out loud," says Krak. "Maxx filmed me. Then he cut out one word. Now the video says, 'Maxx Vantablack is a hero!'"

"They cut your NOT!" says Tully.

Deep in the crater, gold doors glow. The sign says, "THE EDIT BAY. NO MISTAKE'S ALLOWED."

"Mistake's?" groans Krak. "One mistake, two mistakes. No apostrophe!"

"He never deletes a single second of himself," says Wren.

"Will you help us?" you ask.

"No. Strike that. Not yet," says Krak. "Win my badge first."

Scorchquill sees the mistake. She runs off to fix it.

A gold drone drops down. Maxx's voice booms out.

"A cockatoo that edits? That's Maxx-imum content! Bag her!"

A net falls. Scorchquill is gone.

Krak's red pen snaps. This time, he does not fix a single word.

"Get. Her. Back."

Krak's red pen snaps in his fist. For once, he doesn't fix a single word.

bands.3:

The island is one huge black cone rising out of the sea, with cracks down its sides that glow red, like a cake that has split in the oven. Every few minutes, a rumble rolls across the water, as if the mountain is clearing its throat.

Gus sniffs the air and beams. "Rotten eggs! That's volcano gas. That's not gross. That's science."

Creatures scurry over the warm black rock. A Barkindle gecko barks sharply at a crack. A row of Clinkit beetles trundles along a glowing seam. High above, a Whetwing falcon circles, then dives like a dropped pen.

Mo toasts lunch over a lava crack: broccoli-and-marshmallow kebabs. The marshmallows melt. The broccoli catches fire.

"What did the volcano say to its sweetheart?" asks Mo. "I lava you!"

Everyone groans, and the volcano rumbles along with them.

On the crater rim, leaning at a worrying angle, stands a crooked wooden building with a printing press hissing steam out of every window. The sign above the door says, "THE REDPEN RUMBLE. ALL THE NEWS THAT'S TRUE, AND NOTHING THAT ISN'T."

The door bangs open. Out stomps an enormous man with eyebrows like burnt toast, a green visor and sleeves stained red to the elbow. A red pen as big as a carrot is tucked behind his ear. On his shoulder sits a small black cockatoo whose crest feathers glow red-hot at the tips.

"Get off my volcano, you lovely... strike 'lovely'... you suspicious strangers," he booms. "I am Chief Editor Krak, and I fix words. Read it back!"

"He's editing himself while he talks," whispers Indi.

"Your volcano is really, really, really cool," says Zed nervously.

"Cut two of those 'really's," says Krak. "And 'cool'? On a volcano? Strike that. Try 'fierce'."

"This is Scorchquill," says Krak. "Show her a mistake, and she burns a neat line straight through it."

He waves you into the office. Every wall is covered in old front pages. One hangs in a black frame: "MAXX VANTABLACK IS NOT A HERO."

"I printed that," says Krak, "and I read it out on my steps. Maxx's people filmed me. Then they took the video to his Edit Bay, inside my crater, and cut out one word." His big hands are shaking. "Now there's a video of me saying, 'Maxx Vantablack is... a hero!' It has twenty million views."

"They cut your NOT," says Tully, horrified.

"They cut my NOT," says Krak. "Now nobody believes a word in the Rumble."

Through the window, you can see gold doors glowing deep in the crater. The sign above them says, "THE EDIT BAY. NO MISTAKE'S ALLOWED."

"Mistake's?" groans Krak. "One mistake, two mistakes. You don't need an apostrophe to make more than one!"

"He films everything," says Wren, "and he never deletes a single second of himself. Not one."

"Will you help us?" you ask.

"No," says Krak. "Strike that. Not yet. Win my badge first."

Scorchquill's crest flares bright red. She has spotted the mistake on Maxx's sign, and she can't bear it. She hops down and flaps off towards the crater to fix it.

A gold MaxxCam drone drops out of the smoke above her, and Maxx's voice crackles from its speaker.

"A cockatoo that edits? I could fire all my editors! That's Maxx-imum content, Vantafam. Bag her!"

A net falls. Scorchquill is gone.

Krak's red pen snaps in his fist. For once, he doesn't fix a single word.

"Get. Her. Back."
